descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-05 step 3; TFA-94423 AC 1 · “Confirm speech-to-text runs through a BAA-covered path, not a direct, unauthenticated call.”. Mixed: stated part — The production transcription route is authenticated and reaches only a BAA-covered endpoint; our part — On-device marker refused outside roundai.test, saved values resolving to cloud, native plugin never selected (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Decision D1 · S0 · Daniela

Live dictation audio goes from the browser straight to OpenAI with a 60-second token our server mints, not through our server — acceptable? (Q2)

Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S11 Speech-to-text routes: transcription value by path, authentication and BAA coverage, with the on-device marker locked to test accounts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3a Speech-to-text runs through a BAA-covered, authenticated path, not a direct, unauthenticated call: routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (UAT OAT-05 step 3; TFA-94423 AC 1)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given The code at the UAT commit (convex/ai/transcribe.ts, convex/aiProvider.ts, convex/settings.ts update() and lib/authRows assertTestFixtureUser, src/lib/speech/liveSession.ts, src/lib/dictation.ts resolveDictationEngine, the Capacitor native speech plugin) and the production aiProvider.transcription value (from S19)

When Fill the table. (1) 'gpt-live', live capture: prepareSession, signed-in only, mints a 60 s secret; browser to api.openai.com/v1/realtime/calls; audio over WebRTC to OpenAI. (2) 'gpt-live', recovery of a kept recording: upload to Convex, then whisper-1. …

Then The row production uses is authenticated and reaches only an endpoint the OpenAI BAA covers. No row lets a real physician's audio reach a vendor without authentication or without coverage. The server refuses the on-device marker for an account outside roundai.test, any saved value resolves to the cloud engine, and the native speech plugin is never selected; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 3 'a BAA-covered path, not a direct, unauthenticated call', TFA-94423 AC 1 and AC 2, and Daniela on 2026-10-03 ('never directly from the browser … covered by a BAA'), carried into TFA-94423 and TFA-94700. A row that is unauthenticated, or that reaches an endpoint without confirmed coverage, is a Fail. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

Nothing a physician sees: during live dictation the audio streams from the browser straight to OpenAI over WebRTC, using a 60 s token our server mints, rather than through our server; whether direct-but-authenticated is acceptable is open (Q2).

Evidence: allure b9ca17c8-…-result.json; code-review lane, status fail-pending-Q2. Route 1 (gpt-live live capture) goes to api.openai.com/v1/realtime/calls with the server-minted secret. Recovery and whisper go through the server; voxtral/transcribe values are refused; the on-device marker is limited to @roundai.test accounts (whether that test-only native path is intended is also to confirm). Daniela said on 2026-10-03 'never directly from the browser'. BAA coverage (S08) and the production transcription value (S19, Tim) are other halves.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: CODEREVIEW · Code review; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
